title: Engineering Symphony — Cross-Team Leads Retrospective 2027-03-04
agenda: Capacity planning for upcoming peak (10 min)
notes:
Purpose: short, decision-oriented retrospective to align on cross-team risks for the next two sprints; tone = pragmatic, focused on unblock and measurable next steps.

Metrics snapshot: p50/p95 generation latency (hosted): 18ms / 72ms; p95 has grown by ~6ms week-over-week for medium-length prompts after canary of kernel changes. Serving throughput (tokens/sec per GPU) increased by ~18% in the canary group (model-cand-3) after switching to the K4 attention kernel (see PR #482). Dedicated pool utilization across customers: 62% avg, but two mid-size customers saw sustained spikes causing short saturations on us-west-2 nodes (utilization up to 95% for 4 hours). Observability: error-rate for streaming fallbacks increased to 1.4% from 0.6% due to a regression in chunked transfer logic (SRE-980).

Incidents & mitigations: small cascading degradation on 2027-03-02 02:12 UTC when autoscaler mis-evaluated pending queue sizes, causing thrash and increased tail latency. Immediate mitigation: bumped aggressive-scaling cooldown to 45s (Ruth), reverted an autoscaler heuristic change from last week (Samir). Longer term: Samir to land autoscaler safety gates (ENG-1254) and add synthetic load tests (owner: Samir, due 2027-03-18). Root cause notes: heuristic underweighted KV cache reuse across similar keys; led to transient cold KVs.

Team updates (high level):
- Serving Runtime (Marco): K4 kernel rollout progressing; observed memory regression in edge-cases with seq_len > 8k (investigating). Marco to open a focused PR to cap cache-mapping table growth and add unit tests (PR draft by 03/08). Priority: fix memory regression before expanding kernel rollout to EU regions.
- Platform / Autoscaler (Priya): working on safety gates (ENG-1254) and tighter circuit-breakers for burst scenarios. Started load-profile work with Solutions Eng to model mid-market customer spikes. Request to teams: provide 7-day peak schedule for upcoming marketing promos by 03/10.
- Dedicated (Samir): reservation contracts converting at expected rate; autoscaler changes caused customer-visible throttling for two accounts last weekend — customer success notified and credits applied. Samir to propose a short-term capacity buffer policy (owner: Samir, proposal due 03/11).
- Private Deployments (Lena): onboarding for large regulated customer in финляндия (on-prem VPC workshop complete). Need clear docs for KMS integration flows; ask: Security to prioritize a KMS sample repo (Ruth to coordinate).
- Console + Rollouts (Evelyn): implementing a per-route rollout timeline UI; canaries now surfaced with live SLO deltas. Minor UX bug: rollout diff not showing quantization variant labels (Evelyn -> fix by 03/09).
- Observability (Daniel): added a prefix-KV cache heatmap to dashboards; will instrument end-to-end traces for model-variant fallbacks. Request: teams to tag experiments with experiment-id in requests so tracing links across services (standardize header X-RI-EXPID).
- SRE (Ruth): post-incident audit started; identified gaps in runbook handoffs during overnight shifts. Action: rotate 2 additional on-call mentors for night shift on-call training (owner: Ruth, complete by 03/25).

Cross-team blockers & decisions: 
- Decision: delay full K4 kernel EU expansion until memory regression is fixed and additional canary nodes added (agreed).
- Blocker: KV cache eviction pattern causing higher cold-starts for multi-tenant workloads. Root cause hypothesis: cache sharding imbalance when tenant-affinity keys hash unevenly. Action: Daniel + Marco to provide telemetry slice and a small simulation by 03/12.
- Decision: enforce a 7% dedicated pool buffer for enterprise customers during promo windows for next 60 days (Samir to draft policy).

Action items (owner — due):
- ENG-1254: Autoscaler safety gates + synthetic load tests — Samir — 2027-03-18
- Add unit tests + cap cache-map growth for long sequences — Marco — 2027-03-08
- Propose Dedicated capacity buffer policy + customer communication draft — Samir — 2027-03-11
- Provide 7-day peak marketing/promos schedule from GTM teams — All product owners — 2027-03-10
- KMS sample repo + quickstart for Private deployments — Ruth (Security) & Lena — 2027-03-16
- Console rollout diff labels (quantization variants) fix — Evelyn — 2027-03-09
- Prefix-KV heatmap telemetry slice and simulation — Daniel & Marco — 2027-03-12
- Night-shift on-call mentor program roll-out — Ruth — 2027-03-25

Risks flagged: 
- If the memory regression is not remediated within two sprints, we risk delaying multiple region rollouts and losing projected cost-savings from K4 kernel optimizations (~12% annualized).
- Autoscaler instability recurring during burst windows could drive SLA credits and churn if not addressed quickly.

Decisions / notes for leadership: 
- Approve up to 10 additional canary nodes for EU to speed parallel testing once regression is fixed (funding decision requested from finance by 03/09).
- Approve short-term Dedicated pool buffer for promo windows (Samir to finalize policy).

Parking lot / follow-ups: 
- Explore model-level adaptive quantization toggles per customer class (research spike). Owner: Research/Applied ML, to propose feasibility 03/31.
- Cross-team offsite to run tabletop incident drills (June window) — planning comms to ops by 04/01.

Closing: Next meeting set for 2027-03-11. Please update linked artifacts with PR/JIRA links as you close items. If any owner needs to reassign, ping Priya directly.

Raw links referenced: github.com/redwood/serving-runtime/pull/482, JIRA ENG-1254, SRE-980, confluence.company/engineering/kv-cache-tuning-2027.
